key_relationships: EventDispatcher depends_on Composer\Script\Event (creates ScriptEvent in dispatchScript / doDispatch)
EventDispatcher throws ScriptExecutionException (on non-0 exit code)
EventDispatcher uses ProcessExecutor (execute shell scripts via executeTty)
EventDispatcher uses PartialComposer (getPackage, getConfig, getRepositoryManager, getAutoloadGenerator)
EventDispatcher uses ScriptEvents constants (caller sites use them as eventName strings)
dispatch_flow: dispatchScript() creates ScriptEvent and calls doDispatch(event)
doDispatch() calls getListeners(event) → merges registered listeners + getScriptListeners()
doDispatch() iterates listeners and branches on callable type:
· PHP static method (Class::method) → executeEventPhpScript(className, methodName, event)
· @composer / @script alias → recursive dispatch() with new ScriptEvent + setOriginatingEvent
· Command class (\*Command) → instantiate Symfony Application, run command
doDispatch() checks event.isPropagationStopped() to short-circuit listener loop
ScriptExecutionException thrown on non-0 exit code from shell or @composer scripts
important_notes: BaseEvent (EventDispatcher\Event) uses stopPropagation() / isPropagationStopped() to halt listener chain
Script\Event.setOriginatingEvent() recursively unwraps nested originating events via calculateOriginatingEvent()
EventDispatcher.makeAutoloader() rebuilds the Composer classloader on first call per listener per package-set hash
COMPOSER_SKIP_SCRIPTS env var prevents execution of specific script names
COMPOSER_DEBUG_EVENTS env var enables debug logging in doDispatch()
dispatchPackageEvent and dispatchInstallerEvent require a full Composer (not PartialComposer) — enforced by assert
eventStack tracks active events and throws RuntimeException on circular script references
